Data policy: no fabricated proxies. World Bank and IMF annual series provide the durable public skeleton; SAFE provides official daily RMB fixing data; PBC cards show latest official monetary prints where history is not yet wired. 数据原则：不制造 proxy。World Bank 与 IMF 年度序列提供可维护的公开骨架；SAFE 提供官方人民币日度中间价；PBC 卡片展示暂未接入历史序列的最新官方货币数据。

PPI - CPI Industrial Margin Scissors & Transmission (pp)PPI - CPI 工业利润剪刀差与价格传导机制 (百分点)

Analytical Framework: When PPI - CPI > 0 (Upstream Expansion Zone), upstream mining and raw material producers capture higher pricing power, elevating intermediate input costs. When PPI - CPI < 0 (Downstream Compression / Deflationary Drag Zone), downstream firms absorb factory-gate deflation without retail elasticity, suppressing corporate operating profits. 分析框架：当 PPI - CPI > 0（上游利润扩张区），上游采掘与原材料行业议价能力增强，中下游面临成本推升；当 PPI - CPI < 0（工业通缩承压区），工业品价格持续低于消费终端，反映需求不足与中下游利润承压。
